rules.description: Ensures list price is not negative

impact.reason: Negative prices can cause revenue and reporting errors

rules.description: Ensures stock quantity is not negative

impact.reason: Negative inventory breaks fulfillment and allocation logic

rules.rule: products.launch_date IS NULL OR products.launch_date <= CURRENT_DATE
rules.description: Launch date must not be in the future

impact.reason: Future launch dates distort product availability reporting

rules.rule: (products.launch_date IS NULL OR products.discontinued_date IS NULL) OR (products.launch_date <= products.discontinued_date)
rules.description: Launch date must precede or equal discontinued date when both are present

impact.reason: Inconsistent timeline makes product lifecycle analysis unreliable

rules.rule: products.is_active = false OR products.discontinued_date IS NULL
rules.description: Active products cannot have a discontinuation date

impact.reason: Discrepancy between status and discontinuation can lead to incorrect catalog exposure

rules.rule: products.discontinued_date IS NULL OR products.is_active = false
rules.description: Products with a discontinuation date must be marked inactive

impact.reason: Ensures catalog reflects true product availability

rules.rule: products.is_active = false OR (products.launch_date IS NOT NULL AND products.launch_date <= CURRENT_DATE)
rules.description: Active products must have a launch date that is not in the future

impact.reason: Prevents products from being shown as active before they exist
